_readme: The 100 prospect homepages Momentum 360 completed as of 2026-08-05 (batches B1-B4). Used by the site grader as (a) an exclusion list so discovery never re-pitches a business we already built for, and (b) a labelled calibration corpus: every row here was judged worth a build, so any row whose site grades as strong/elite is a build we should not have spent. Emails and street addresses from the source sheet are deliberately omitted - this repo is public (see CLAUDE.md). The full verified-contact sheet stays out of Git.
_source: Momentum 360 - 100 Completed Prospect Websites + Verified Contacts (PDF, 2026-08-05)

_fields.own_site_found: false means the source sheet cited only a trade-association or municipal directory, not a site of their own - those rows cannot be graded
_fields.outreach_readiness: ready_phone_email = verified phone AND public email; phone_or_form_only = no public email located
_fields.email_count: count only, addresses intentionally omitted from this public repo
